title: Adherence Programs and the Kestrel Rx Savings Club Generic Price — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
The patient's automated refill enrollment in active status under Auto Refill & Medication Sync decides how the discounted Kestrel Rx Savings Club price of a generic fill of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs is finished. The discounted price here is the usual and customary price after the club discount percentage has been taken and the result rounded to the cent half up.

- Under **Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day** or **Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day**, a flat 90-day adherence credit of **2.00 dollars** is taken off the discounted price.
- Under **any other automated refill program in active status**, the discounted price is multiplied by **0.98** and rounded to the cent half up.
- With **no automated refill enrollment in active status**, the discounted price stands as it is.

This finish concerns a generic fill sold for cash that is not on the Kestrel Value Generics list; a brand fill is not finished this way.

## Questions answered

**Does a paused or cancelled refill enrollment count?** No. Only an automated refill enrollment in active status counts; with none in active status the discounted price stands as it is.

**Is the 2.00-dollar credit a percentage?** No. It is a flat amount taken off the discounted price.

**How is the 0.98 figure applied?** The discounted price is multiplied by 0.98, which takes 2 percent off it, and the result is rounded to the cent half up.

## Hypothetical figures on a discounted price of $30.00

| Active automated refill enrollment | Finished price |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | $28.00 |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | $28.00 |
| Another automated refill program | $29.40 |
| None in active status | $30.00 |
